{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to only the treatment arm
treatment_df = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute the fraction of patients who responded
fraction_responded = treatment_df['responded'].mean()

# Print the number of patients in the treatment arm (to avoid estimation)
num_treatment_patients = len(treatment_df)

# Print the fraction
print(fraction_responded)
print(num_treatment_patients)"}
